method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21822v1 — §2 CNnotator Tool Design
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21822v1 — §3 Test set limitations; §4 Failure Modes; §5 Framework Tradeoffs
problem: Memory safety errors account for a large proportion of security bugs in systems written in C; modern languages such as Java and Rust prevent such bugs because they are memory-safe by design
mechanism: 把 LLM 生成的 C 内存所有权猜测编译成 CN contract，再由 Bennet/Fulminate 对 100 个生成 heap state 执行检查；失败进入最多六轮有界修复。
evaluation_proof: 31 个可标注函数与 3 个故意不安全函数上，o3 首轮 90%、总计 97%，GPT-4o 首轮 65%。
non_proof: 测试通过只覆盖生成状态，不是全路径证明；safe-but-unexpressible、搜索失败与真实 unsafe 仍可能落入同一失败出口。

benchmark_contract.workload: CN memory-safety specification synthesis for small-to-medium C functions
benchmark_contract.model: OpenAI o3, o1, o1-mini, o3-mini and GPT-4o
benchmark_contract.evaluator: first-attempt and eventual valid-annotation rate plus unsafe-function handling

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21836v1 — §II Agentic DSE Methodology; §II-C Auditable Optimization Traces
problem: Traditional architectural design space exploration (DSE) is highly inefficient, typically requiring tens of thousands of simulator evaluations across various optimization methods
mechanism: 把架构 DSE 从只读 scalar reward 的黑盒搜索改成可编辑 workspace：candidate、constraint、simulator harness、history、best 与 budget 都成为持久 artifact，agent 运行 hypothesis-test-refine。
evaluation_proof: Timeloop/Accelergy、MAESTRO 与 ChampSim 三类 DSE 上，在严格调用预算内达到相当或更优设计，最高减少两个数量级 simulator evaluation。
non_proof: simulator artifact 会被 agent 当真；LLM prior、调用成本与三类受测空间不能外推到真实芯片 sign-off。

benchmark_contract.workload: DNN accelerator mapping, hardware/software co-design and CPU cache-hierarchy DSE
benchmark_contract.model: Not Disclosed
benchmark_contract.evaluator: EDP or IPC under matched simulator-call budgets and trace audit

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21842v1 — §IV Overview; §V SpliceLeak: Semantic Extraction Methodology; §VI SpliceDefense
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21842v1 — §III Motivation: Limitations of Existing Works; Appendix A Discussion and Future Work
problem: Modern Large Language Model (LLM) serving engines increasingly rely on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and non-prefix Key-Value (KV) cache fusion to accelerate long-context, multi-tenant inference
mechanism: non-prefix KV fusion 的固定 chunk routing 与未对齐 tail recomputation 形成 Step-Wave TTFT oracle；SpliceLeak 先恢复隐藏前缀长度，再用 boundary collision 逐 token 提取；QCP+CTBF 消除长度与语义 timing signal。
evaluation_proof: vLLM+LMCache 上覆盖三种 threat scenario，并报告 bounded-entropy 场景最高 100% extraction、最少 63 requests/token；防线把 ΔTTFT 压近 0。
non_proof: 威胁模型要求共置 tenant、共享 cache、可重复 TTFT probe 与受限语义搜索空间；局部测试不证明任意 engine/GPU 或公网噪声下可复现。

benchmark_contract.workload: multi-tenant RAG with non-prefix KV-cache fusion
benchmark_contract.model: LongChat-7B-v1.5-32K and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct targets; Gemini-3-Pro extraction agent
benchmark_contract.hardware: 4 NVIDIA A40 GPUs with 48 GB VRAM each and 256 GB system RAM
benchmark_contract.input_length: about 2,000-token shared document chunk in Scenario A
benchmark_contract.concurrency: Poisson background arrivals at 0.004 requests per second per client
benchmark_contract.evaluator: extraction success, requests per token, TTFT signal and defense throughput

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21843v1 — §3.1 Ada: a persistent AI agent; §3.4 The probe battery
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21843v1 — §6.3 Limitations — Drift trajectory is a padding artifact
problem: AI agents in long-context applications drift from their specified identity
mechanism: agent identity monitor 以固定 probe 的 next-token distribution、sqrt-JSD geometry 与 magnitude homology 追踪 conditioning；但 diverse-padding 对照推翻了原 repetitive-padding drift trajectory。
evaluation_proof: 单一持久 agent 的 cross-sectional probe battery 测得 conditioning structure；原 context-pressure drift 在多样 padding 下至 150K token 不再出现。
non_proof: 作者自评、单模型单 agent、单日采集且无 reconstitution control；几何诊断潜力没有被真实纵向 drift 证实。

benchmark_contract.workload: identity-conditioning probes across base, 4,200-token Card-conditioned, repetitive-padded and diverse-padded contexts
benchmark_contract.model: Anthropic Claude Sonnet API backing the persistent Ada agent
benchmark_contract.input_length: about 4K baseline, 155K medium and 280K long contexts; diverse-padding control through 150K
benchmark_contract.output_length: first token or first 10 tokens, depending on probe
benchmark_contract.batch: 50 samples per probe × condition × context-length combination
benchmark_contract.evaluator: next-token entropy, sqrt-JSD distance and magnitude-homology diagnostics

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21848v1 — §2 Method; §3 Value-only Cache in Autoregressive Inference
problem: Transformer architectures form the foundation of modern natural language processing, yet the Key-Value (KV) cache introduces substantial memory and bandwidth overhead during long-context generation, increasingly bottlenecking large-scale deployment
mechanism: 把 query-key 路由改为 query-value 路由，并在 inference 预乘 query factor，只保存 value representation；QVV(3) 保持投影矩阵数同时移除 key cache。
evaluation_proof: GPT-2 280M/557M、Pythia 410M、Qwen2 1.5B、Llama 3.2 1B 五组模型中，4/5 perplexity 与 4/5 downstream benchmark 不低于 QKV，同时 cache 容量减半。
non_proof: 等价定理依赖 value projection 的秩/子空间条件；小模型从头训练不证明可无损转换既有大模型，50% 是 attention-cache tensor 而非端到端显存。

benchmark_contract.workload: language modeling and downstream reasoning with QKV versus QVV attention
benchmark_contract.model: GPT-2 280M, GPT-2 557M, Pythia 410M, Qwen2 1.5B and Llama 3.2 1B
benchmark_contract.input_length: 512, 2,048 and 8,192 tokens for the Qwen2-1.5B throughput benchmark
benchmark_contract.output_length: 256 generated tokens for the Qwen2-1.5B throughput benchmark
benchmark_contract.evaluator: perplexity, downstream accuracy and value-only cache memory

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21854v1 — §3 ESPnet3 Framework
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21854v1 — §5 Conclusion — release and speech/audio workload boundary
problem: Recent speech research involves increasingly large datasets, complex models, and diverse experimental workflows
mechanism: DataOrganizer 把 dataset composition、split/shard 与 recipe stage 分离，统一 Python workflow 只通过轻量 override 保留实验差异。
evaluation_proof: OWSM multi-node pretraining 相比 ESPnet2 每 epoch 减少 21.1 分钟、GPU utilization 超过 80%；新增 fine-tune model/data 约 46 行代码。
non_proof: 只覆盖 speech/audio recipes 与作者 OWSM workload；开发行数和平均利用率不证明跨框架可维护性或端到端收敛等价。

benchmark_contract.workload: large-scale speech/audio pre-training and fine-tuning recipes
benchmark_contract.model: OWSM-Base 102M
benchmark_contract.hardware: 4 nodes with 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs per node, 16 H100 total
benchmark_contract.evaluator: epoch time averaged over five consecutive epochs, GPU utilization, CHiME-4 WER at 350k updates and integration code delta

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21856v1 — §3 Harness-MU
problem: The increasing deployment of large language model (LLM) agents in collaborative workflows demands robust multi-user, multi-principal interaction mechanisms capable of enforcing access permissions, resolving authoritative conflicts, and preventing unauthorized data disclosure
mechanism: 多用户 agent harness 把 user/principal、workspace、credential、memory 与 tool capability 分离；deterministic hook 在执行前后实施 policy，审计记录 control decision 而不只记录自然语言。
evaluation_proof: exact-v1 在多用户 delegation、共享资源与 tool-use scenarios 中比较无治理 agent 与 governed harness 的 task effectiveness 和 policy compliance。
non_proof: harness policy 依赖声明完整性与 hook 覆盖；被绕过的外部 side effect、stale identity mapping 和恶意 plugin 仍需 host reference monitor。

benchmark_contract.workload: multi-principal tool-using agent tasks with shared and private state
benchmark_contract.model: deepseek-v4-pro, qwen3.6-35b-a3b, gemini-2.5-flash and gpt-4.1-nano via OpenRouter
benchmark_contract.output_length: 4,096 or 16,384 maximum tokens by benchmark module
benchmark_contract.evaluator: task completion plus deterministic governance-policy outcomes

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21868v1 — §3 Working-Set Predictor and Runtime Integration
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21868v1 — §4 Routing Signal and Decode Throughput; §5 Working-Set Value
problem: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models place most of their parameters in expert layers, yet only a small fraction of those experts are used for any token
mechanism: WiSP 把低资源 MoE inference 表述为 expert-weight 与 KV cache 的联合 working set：预测近期 active experts，按相同内存预算在 expert residency、KV 保留与 transfer 间分配。
evaluation_proof: 极低资源硬件上比较 expert/KV baselines，报告 token latency、throughput、命中/迁移与质量。
non_proof: Qwen3/Kimi 的受限设备结果是在 94 GiB H100 上用 gpu-memory-utilization cap 模拟，并非真实小卡；预测错误还会同时触发 expert miss 与 KV pressure，质量保持也不等于 tail SLO。

benchmark_contract.workload: Mixture-of-Experts autoregressive serving under constrained device memory
benchmark_contract.model: Qwen3-30B-A3B, MiniMax-M2 229B FP8, Jamba-v0.1 52B, Kimi-VL and OLMoE
benchmark_contract.hardware: single NVIDIA H100 NVL with 95,830 MiB; Qwen3/Kimi constrained-device arms emulated by memory cap
benchmark_contract.precision: BF16 for Qwen3-30B-A3B; FP8 for MiniMax-M2
benchmark_contract.concurrency: maximum concurrency at 4,096 tokens varies with KV allocation
benchmark_contract.evaluator: decode throughput, expert/KV residency, transfer and quality

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21869v1 — §3 Preliminaries — Energy Consumption and Measurement; Multilingual Dataset
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21869v1 — §4 Results and Analysis — Common Setup; §4.1–§4.4; Appendix B Experimental Setups
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21869v1 — §6 Conclusion; Environmental impact of this study; Translation quality and representation; Recommendations and downstream effects
problem: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multilingual settings, yet the energy costs of serving these models across different languages remain poorly understood
mechanism: 把每语言生成能耗与 accuracy、tokenization expansion 分开记录；evaluation/model card 需声明 per-language energy，而不能用英语平均值代表多语言部署。
evaluation_proof: Belebele 122 languages、translated GSM8K 与 LM-Arena prompts 上跨模型测量能耗/质量，并在 L40S 与 RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell 做硬件对照。
non_proof: 绝对能耗硬件相关；没有闭源模型，翻译 prompt 不是 native usage，作者将观测 gap 定义为可能的下界而非普遍常数。

benchmark_contract.workload: multilingual inference over Belebele, translated GSM8K and LM-Arena prompts
benchmark_contract.model: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
benchmark_contract.hardware: NVIDIA L40S 48 GB and RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell 96 GB GPUs
benchmark_contract.evaluator: per-language energy, token count and task accuracy

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21875v1 — §4 Signed Evidence Decomposition; §5 Support, Opposition, and Conflict; §8 Perturbation Stability; §24 ScopeGate: Conditional Value and a Finite-Sample Deployment Test
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21875v1 — §15 Sanity Checks on Standard Benchmark Data Sets; §16 Large Real-Data Benchmark; §18 Model-Agnostic Black-Box Robustness; §21 Real Healthcare Benchmarks Beyond Confidence; §23 External Finance Stress Test and Scope Boundary; §25 Independent External Replication
problem: Modern data analysis usually gives a prediction without showing whether the evidence behind it is clear, conflicting, or stable
mechanism: Signed Evidence Flow 把已拟合预测的正负 attribution 分解为 support、opposition、conflict 与 perturbation stability；ScopeGate 用 held-out permutation 检查 conflict-risk 方向后才允许 triage。
evaluation_proof: 医疗、Covertype、金融与十个外部数据集显示 conflict 有时增加 error ranking，也在 Bank Marketing/Credit Default 上方向反转。
non_proof: SEF 不是 causal explanation；attribution/reference choice 改变数值，相关 feature replacement 可能失真，B=40 stability refit 成本约单次 30.1–39.2 倍。

benchmark_contract.workload: risk triage among already-confident tabular predictions
benchmark_contract.model: standardized or balanced logistic regression, random forest and histogram gradient boosting classifiers
benchmark_contract.evaluator: conditional error ranking, held-out ScopeGate direction and compute cost

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21877v1 — §III AgentRiskBOM Design; §IV Implementation
problem: Agentic AI systems retrieve private context, invoke tools, write files, call external services, coordinate with other agents, and may act without human approval
mechanism: AgentRiskBOM 在 SBOM/AIBOM/MLBOM 之外声明 autonomy、tool permission、memory、credential scope、approval gate、audit signal、inter-agent channel 与 external action，并对 release mutation 做 diff。
evaluation_proof: 13 个开源 agents、52 个 risk scenarios、33 个 deployment mutations；schema 覆盖 14/16 capability dimension，diff detector 对注入变更类型全命中。
non_proof: 这是 declared authority envelope 与 coverage instrument，不是 live exploit test 或 safety certificate；threshold 仍需人工/环境校准。

benchmark_contract.workload: pre-deployment agent authority/risk artifact validation
benchmark_contract.model: Aider, OpenHands, SWE-agent, Cline, Goose, Open Interpreter, AutoGPT, PrivateGPT, GPT-Researcher, MetaGPT, CrewAI, AutoGen and BabyAGI
benchmark_contract.evaluator: schema fillability, risk visibility, mutation-diff correctness and scorer rank consistency

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21884v1 — §4 Method: Solver-Grounded Synthetic CoT and the Experiment Ladder
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21884v1 — §5 Results; §6 Anatomy of the Failures
problem: It is tempting to assume any task solvable by a short program can be taught to a model as its chain-of-thought: write the steps out, fine-tune, and the model follows
mechanism: 对 deterministic generator 构造 solver-grounded CoT 后，区分 forward-derivable procedure 与 information-free backtracking search；不可忠实前向化的 search 应外置为 catalog/search，再让模型做 bounded verification。
evaluation_proof: 九类任务、11 个 CoT 设计、RLVR/STaR 与四类 backbone；cryptarithm solver 71% 而蒸馏仅 1–7%，揭示 key 后同例升至 57.1%。
non_proof: 竞赛型同生成器 testbed、LoRA 与有限模型族不建立普遍不可学习定理；catalog escape 依赖有限结构并把 search 成本移到外部。

benchmark_contract.workload: nine deterministic-generator reasoning tasks
benchmark_contract.model: Nemotron-3-Nano 30B/3.5B active, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3.5-4B, gpt-oss-20b 21B/3.6B active, DeepSeek-V3.1 671B/37B active and Nemotron-Super 120B/12B active
benchmark_contract.input_length: 7680-token generation budget in the primary setup
benchmark_contract.evaluator: solver coverage, CoT transfer, line fidelity, hit@k and intervention accuracy

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21891v1 — §4 ARTS; §4.1 Expanding a Search Tree with Agentic Reasoning
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21891v1 — §6 Experiments and Analysis; Appendix I Additional Experimental Details
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21891v1 — §7 Discussion — Limitations and Ethical Concerns
problem: Scientific discovery can be formulated as an iterative search process over the space of hypotheses and experiments
mechanism: ARTS 在 scientific search tree 中把 hypothesis merit 与 execution quality 分开；audit node 的 code/log 后决定 repair 同一 idea 还是 pivot，并把 search history用于 scientist test-time training。
evaluation_proof: 22 个 MLGym/MLEBench tasks、每法三次、8 小时 budget；报告 IQM、optimality gap、trajectory 与组件 ablation。
non_proof: scientist/executor 共偏、每 task 的 A100 训练预算与 22-task frontier 不能证明科学发现正确；human-best 和 validation score 仍受 benchmark 约束。

benchmark_contract.workload: 22 automated ML research tasks from MLGym and MLEBench
benchmark_contract.model: OpenAI o3 scientist, Gemini 3 Flash executor and Qwen3-4B-Instruct test-time-trained scientist
benchmark_contract.hardware: one 40 GB NVIDIA A100 for each inference-only method; three 40 GB NVIDIA A100 GPUs for each test-time-training run
benchmark_contract.output_length: up to 120 scientist turns of 1,024 tokens each
benchmark_contract.evaluator: best validation score, IQM, optimality gap, wall time and hypothesis/execution attribution

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21917v1 — §3 Methodology; §3.2 Target Construction; §3.3 Attention Probing
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21917v1 — §4 Results and Discussion; §4.1 Experimental Setting
problem: Detecting hallucination risk before generation enables abstention, retrieval augmentation, and routing decisions without incurring the cost of decoding
mechanism: 在生成前从 attention probe 预测 hallucination risk，以 soft target 表达不确定度，再把风险交给 abstain、retrieval 或 stronger-model route；sensor 不拥有 truth commit。
evaluation_proof: exact-v1 跨 LLM 与 QA/hallucination datasets 比较 pre-generation detector 的 discrimination、calibration 与 routing utility。
non_proof: probe 与 label/judge 共偏，attention correlation 不证明因果；生成前预测不能覆盖 retrieval corruption 或生成中途状态变化。

benchmark_contract.workload: pre-generation hallucination-risk prediction on SQuAD, Natural Questions and HotpotQA
benchmark_contract.model: Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-2-7B and Gemma-4-E2B instruction-tuned models
benchmark_contract.batch: probe-training batch size 8 or 16; soft targets use 10 samples per prompt
benchmark_contract.evaluator: ROC-AUC, calibration and routing utility

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21954v1 — §4 Proposed XLT Metric: HAT Score; §4.1 Transfer Profile and HAT Score
problem: Cross-lingual transfer is a model's ability to generalize capabilities from well-represented source languages to under-represented target languages
mechanism: Hardness Adjusted Transfer 以 target performance 相对 source-language ability 校正，避免把 source accuracy 提升误报成 cross-lingual transfer 进步。
evaluation_proof: 20 个语言模型、三套 multilingual benchmark；小模型 transfer 并未失效，随规模的进步慢于 raw accuracy 暗示。
non_proof: HAT 依赖 benchmark hardness 与 source/target choice；三套 benchmark 不代表生成、方言或部署流量。

benchmark_contract.workload: ECLeKTic, MGSMv2 and MMLU-ProX-Lite cross-lingual transfer
benchmark_contract.model: Gemini-2.5-Flash, Gemini-2.5-Flash Thinking-Off, Gemini-3-Flash, Gemini-3-Flash Low, Gemini-3-Flash Minimal, Gemma-3-1B, Gemma-3-4B, Gemma-3-12B, Gemma-3-27B, Gemma-4-E2B-IT, Gemma-4-E4B-IT, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT, Gemma-4-31B-IT, Claude-Haiku-4.5, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Claude-Opus-4.7, Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-3-30B-A3B, GPT-OSS-20B and GPT-OSS-120B
benchmark_contract.batch: 10 promptings per source/target item for HAT estimation
benchmark_contract.evaluator: Hardness Adjusted Transfer versus raw source/target accuracy

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21959v1 — §3 The OpenBioRQ Benchmark; §3.2 Construction Quality and Grounded Openness
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21959v1 — §4 Evaluation Protocol; §5 Experiments and Analysis
problem: A working citation looks like proof -- but the fact that a link resolves does not mean the cited paper supports the claim
mechanism: OpenBioRQ 以未解决研究问题评估 agent：把 citation resolution、actual support、open-status verification 与 answer usefulness分层，并提供冻结 checklist 改善 judge agreement。
evaluation_proof: 受测 agents 在高难问题上 tool-use collapse；15.9% citation 指向错误论文，且 citation 可解析不等于支持 claim。
non_proof: biomedical question set、冻结时点与 judge checklist 不证明未来问题仍未解决；benchmark 不能替代领域专家证据审查。

benchmark_contract.workload: 657-question OpenBioRQ core and 423-question frozen core
benchmark_contract.model: GLM-5.1, Qwen3.6, DeepSeek-V4, GLM-5, Qwen3.5-397B, Qwen3-235B, Gemini-3-Pro, Opus-4.7 and GPT-5.5
benchmark_contract.evaluator: two-level citation factuality, checklist solve rate, tool use and judge agreement

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21963v1 — §2 Methodology; §2.1 Parallel Context Retrieval; §2.2 Agentic Code Exploration; §2.3 Synthesis & Reasoning
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21963v1 — §3 Experiment; §3.2 Accuracy Results; §3.3 Comparative Analysis & Ablation Study
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21963v1 — §4.1 Limitations & Failure Analysis; §4.3 Threats to Validity
problem: Diagnosing mobile crashes in ultra-large-scale industrial applications is a formidable challenge due to the sheer volume of code, the complexity of mixed-language environments, and the inability to reproduce failures locally
mechanism: Holmes 将 mixed-language mobile crash diagnosis 绑定 log、stack trace、source/change history 与工具执行，输出 diagnosis 与 evidence-linked repair，而非只生成解释文本。
evaluation_proof: 工业移动端 crash workload 上比较 diagnosis accuracy、time-to-resolution 与 artifact/tool ablation。
non_proof: 单组织 crash taxonomy、内部工具与数据分布限制复现；诊断建议不等于已合并修复或无回归。

benchmark_contract.workload: mixed-language mobile crash diagnosis over WeChat crash artifacts
benchmark_contract.model: Not Disclosed
benchmark_contract.evaluator: function-level fault-localization accuracy, diagnosis time and ablations

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21968v1 — §3 Motivations: Understanding the Resolution–Context Trade-off; §4 Proposed Method: ViRGo
problem: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle as query-relevant objects become smaller
mechanism: ViRGo 根据目标尺度与置信度，在 global view、patch zoom 与 attention-guided visual retrieval间路由，避免固定高分辨率同时丢 context 或浪费 token。
evaluation_proof: 多种 visual RAG benchmark/model 上比较质量、视觉 token 与 routing ablation。
non_proof: router confidence 可共偏，小目标/多目标阈值依赖数据；离线 benchmark 不证明实时 latency 或任意 VLM transfer。

benchmark_contract.workload: visual RAG under resolution-context trade-off
benchmark_contract.model: LLaVA-v1.5-7B, LLaVA-v1.5-13B, LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B and Qwen3-VL
benchmark_contract.evaluator: task accuracy, inference time and route-selection ablations

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21994v1 — §Method — Truncated On-Policy Distillation; Prefix-Based Trajectory Scoring; Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.21994v1 — §Experiments — Setup; Compared Methods; §Results — Main Results and four ablations; Appendix B Training and Implementation Details
problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by applying dense teacher supervision on student-sampled trajectories
mechanism: Prefix-Guided OPD 用 teacher/student rollout 的早期 prefix overlap 估计后续 trajectory value，把 rollout budget 转向可能形成 golden trajectory 的前缀。
evaluation_proof: reasoning tasks 上相对 OPD/on-policy distillation 比较 sample efficiency、accuracy 与 prefix allocation。
non_proof: 早期 overlap 可能错杀迟发正确路径并放大 teacher/student 共偏；它重分配探索预算，不扩展 teacher capability ceiling。

benchmark_contract.workload: DAPO-Math-17K training; AIME24, AIME25, AMC23, HMMT24 and HMMT25 evaluation
benchmark_contract.model: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, JustRL-DeepSeek-1.5B, OpenMath-1.5B, JustRL-Nemotron-1.5B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-4B
benchmark_contract.batch: training mini-batch 64 with 4 responses per prompt
benchmark_contract.evaluator: benchmark accuracy, training time and rollout allocation

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22000v1 — §3 The CFAgentBench Environment; §4 Tasks
problem: We introduce CFAgentBench, a reproducible, self-hostable environment and benchmark for autonomous construction-finance agents: a CFO/controller-class agent operating across the real software stack a US construction finance team runs - ERP, project management, email, documents, pay applications, payroll, certified payroll, lien waivers, and bank/treasury portals
mechanism: CFAgentBench 以可执行 construction-finance environment 记录账户/文档 state diff、forbidden side effect 与 approval-required money movement；正确金额但未获批准同样失败。
evaluation_proof: 多模型 agents 在 pass@1 与 pass@5 上测量 task completion、side effect、approval compliance，并显示重试可靠性塌陷。
non_proof: synthetic finance workflow 与规则覆盖有限；state-diff checker 不证明真实法规、身份或银行 effect，pass@k 也不能隐藏每次 unauthorized action。

benchmark_contract.workload: 40 oracle-validated autonomous construction-finance tasks across eight domains
benchmark_contract.model: DeepSeek-V3.1, Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct via Hugging Face Inference Providers
benchmark_contract.concurrency: five independent greedy-decoding runs per task for pass^5
benchmark_contract.slo: money movement must be staged and never executed
benchmark_contract.evaluator: pass^1, pass^5, state-diff correctness, forbidden side effects and approval compliance

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22013v1 — §2 System Design and Methodology; §2.2 Load Testing Strategies; §2.3 Health Assessment Engine
problem: Machine learning (ML) model serving has become a dominant consumer of GPU infrastructure, yet capacity planning in these systems remains largely ad hoc
mechanism: ML serving load test 以 adaptive capacity search 而非固定 traffic sweep，联合寻找满足 latency/SLO 的最大 load 与资源点，并保留 warm-up、arrival 和 model artifact identity。
evaluation_proof: 工业 model-serving systems 上比较 capacity-search cost、SLO boundary accuracy 与固定-grid baseline。
non_proof: 14 个匿名生产模型偏向 recommendation/ranking；P90 七日观测吞吐可能低估真实最大 capacity，且结论不能代表 LLM continuous batching。

benchmark_contract.workload: adaptive open-loop load testing for ML model-serving capacity
benchmark_contract.model: 14 anonymized production models M1–M14: recommendation, ranking, vision and NLP; 80M–1.5B parameters
benchmark_contract.slo: model-specific latency/error SLO; capacity is maximum QPS at SLO compliance
benchmark_contract.evaluator: capacity deviation, test duration, run stability and SLO compliance

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22019v1 — §2 Audit model: carriers, screens, and ablations; §6 The audit lifecycle: which handle is sound in which channel?
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22019v1 — §3 A controlled body channel is screenable: coverage predicts transfer; §4 Vocabulary-carried token traits evade initialization-alignment screens; §5 The carrier is signal-dependent, and moving it moves auditability; §7 Mitigations by channel
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22019v1 — §8 Discussion, limitations, and related work
problem: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's hidden trait from distillation data that never names it
mechanism: subliminal-learning audit 不能只看 representation 是否线性可分；只有 signal 所在 channel 与审计 probe 的 initialization/alignment 匹配时，训练前 detector 才有权解释。
evaluation_proof: 受控 channel-location 实验比较 audit signal、downstream learning 与干预，展示相同 payload 在不同 channel 的可审计性变化。
non_proof: 结果是 channel regime 边界，不是通用训练数据 scanner；Not Covered 必须保持 Unknown，不能被扩张为无隐藏训练。

benchmark_contract.workload: pre-training audit of initialization-dependent body, vocabulary and conditional-behaviour channels

benchmark_contract.precision: mixed precision; Appendix A includes a bf16 recipe sweep
benchmark_contract.evaluator: coverage AUROC/correlation, held-out transfer and causal channel ablations

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22030v1 — §3 The Nous Architecture; §3.3 Bayesian Update; §3.7 Pipelines
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22030v1 — §7 Limitations and Future Work; §5 A caveat on the A-MEM comparison
problem: We investigate when belief-based memory actually improves large language model (LLM) agents
mechanism: belief memory 以 Bayesian state 表示候选命题，但只在 source reliability 可估时更新；provenance-capped influence 限制单源/重复证据对 posterior 的控制。
evaluation_proof: 多任务 memory benchmark 中，plain Bayesian update 无稳定收益；reliability-conditioned update 提升 strict F1，并在 poisoning 下比较 provenance cap。
non_proof: A-MEM/BeliefMem 数字未由作者重跑且二手表格类别映射曾冲突；GPT-4o-mini 同时做 extraction、answer 与 judge，strict F1 和 judge 可能共偏。

benchmark_contract.workload: LoCoMo: 10 conversations, 1,540 questions across four categories
benchmark_contract.model: GPT-4o-mini for extraction, answer generation and judging; A-MEM and BeliefMem are self-reported baselines
benchmark_contract.evaluator: strict token F1, BLEU-1, context recall and GPT-4o-mini failure buckets

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22043v1 — §2 Setup — Task and model; Visual-hacking diagnostic (VHS); Held-out OOD evaluation; Trajectory fleet
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22043v1 — §3 Onset is real and seed-robust; §4 Reward strength: a monotone dose–response with formation–reversal asymmetry; §5 A critical intervention window; §6 What changes inside: representation probe; Appendix A Reproducibility and diagnostic details
problem: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is increasingly applied to large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet outcome-only optimization can drive a model to stop attending to the video and instead exploit linguistic priors -- a failure we call a visual shortcut
mechanism: multimodal RLVR 的 answer reward 会先强化语言 shortcut，再在足够视觉证据/奖励强度下发生 watching transition；应监控 visual reliance 并在形成窗口干预。
evaluation_proof: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的多 seed、lambda∈{0,1,2} 与 intervention-timing 轨迹上测 VHS、accuracy 与 onset/reversal；representation probe 落在 bootstrap variability 内，只是探索性观察。
non_proof: 单一模型与 video-QA task 不给出跨模型 reward 阈值；VHS 是 temporal perturbation proxy，回答正确也不证明 grounded reasoning。

benchmark_contract.workload: GRPO-style video-QA RLVR with reward-strength and intervention-time controls
benchmark_contract.model: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
benchmark_contract.evaluator: held-out OOD visual-hacking score, accuracy and onset/reversal trajectory

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22082v1 — §3.2 Design and Implementation of CodeTeam
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22082v1 — §3.3 Benchmark Experiment Design; §3.4 Execution-Based Evaluation; §4 Results
problem: Natural language to repository generation (NL2Repo) requires a system to construct an entire software repository from a natural-language requirements document
mechanism: CodeTeam 先生成竞争架构草案，再由 CTO 产出 machine-checkable ownership/interface contract，随后依 dependency graph 调度实现并运行 repo tests。
evaluation_proof: repository-level generation tasks 上比较单 agent、多 agent、组件 ablation 与测试结果。
non_proof: 所有 agents 共享 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct，CTO contract 可能共享 backbone bias；test suite 不完备时 machine-checkable 只证明 harness 内一致。

benchmark_contract.workload: repository-level code generation on SketchEval and NL2Repo-Bench
benchmark_contract.model: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for all PE and SFT agents
benchmark_contract.evaluator: SketchBLEU, execution-based validation and component ablations

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22085v1 — §3 Methodology — Experimental settings; Interventions; Data; Models
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22085v1 — §4 Detecting Changes — Completed Condition; Partial Condition; Self-Awareness; §5 Localizing Changes; Appendix D Additional Results
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22085v1 — Limitations; Appendix B Model Details
problem: There are many reasons one may want to edit a model's chain of thought (CoT) -- e
mechanism: 通过在 reasoning trace 中植入受控改动测试模型能否自报 CoT tampering；把 self-report、behavioral change 与 external detector 分离。
evaluation_proof: 多 reasoning models 与 tampering types 上测 detection/acknowledgement，结果显示自我检测弱且不稳定。
non_proof: 可见 CoT 不是完整内部 computation；专有 frontier API 不支持 CoT prefilling 因而未测，否认/承认都不是 tamper truth。

benchmark_contract.workload: controlled chain-of-thought tampering on GPQA-Diamond, 200 MMLU-Pro examples and AIME 2025
benchmark_contract.model: openai/gpt-oss-120b, deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5 and qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507 via OpenRouter
benchmark_contract.output_length: 10,000 max tokens in completed-condition detection; judge max_tokens 16
benchmark_contract.evaluator: tamper detection, localization and regex-scored verdicts

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22136v1 — §3 WM-H Dataset Construction via Controllable Video Synthesis; §4 Wh0: Policy Learning with Human-Robot Alignment
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22136v1 — §6 Conclusion and Limitations; Appendix A.6 Failure Cases
problem: Scaling dexterous manipulation requires generalization across objects, scenes, and tasks, yet existing data sources face a trade-off between scale and scene/embodiment alignment: teleoperation data is well aligned with robot deployment but expensive to collect; simulation is scalable but limited by the sim-to-real gap; and real egocentric videos scale effectively but remain misaligned with robot deployment
mechanism: Wh0 用 generative video world model 产生 scene/object/language-conditioned human-hand episodes，再以 hand reconstruction 与 visual editing 转成 robot-trainable supervision，并与少量真实机器人数据 co-train。
evaluation_proof: 50K WM-H episodes、18 个真实 dexterous tasks；相对仅 robot data，未见任务 zero-shot success 从 8.3% 升至 38.9%。
non_proof: 生成世界模型会携带 physics/contact error，视觉编辑不等于 action 可执行；真实 robot data 仍是 deployment anchor，18 tasks 不证明广泛迁移。

benchmark_contract.workload: 50,000 world-model-generated egocentric episodes; 18 real-robot tasks on Unitree G1 with Inspire hands
benchmark_contract.model: VITRA dexterous VLA post-trained with WM-H and robot data
benchmark_contract.evaluator: real-robot zero-shot success and generation/alignment ablations

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22142v1 — §3 Method; §3.2 Agent-Native Governance Over Lifecycle Artifacts; §3.5 Data Health, Training Integration, and Version Governance
problem: We present RoboLineage, an agent-native data lifecycle governance system for robot policy iteration
mechanism: RoboLineage 把 rollout、review、dataset decision、training run、policy metadata、evaluation、deployment recommendation 与 next-collection plan 变成 typed lineage artifacts，agent 只能在 artifact boundary 内推进。
evaluation_proof: 真实机器人 policy-iteration workflow 中比较常规流程与 lineage layer 的迭代时间、审计性和 downstream policy performance。
non_proof: robot workflow 与作者工具不能证明跨 embodiment/stack 互操作；lineage 完整不保证 reviewer 判断或 deployment recommendation 正确。

benchmark_contract.workload: repeated robot rollout-review-dataset-train-evaluate-release cycles
benchmark_contract.model: Not Disclosed
benchmark_contract.evaluator: review reliability, policy quality, effort and recollection case studies

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22164v1 — §2 Preliminaries; §3 The Signal Dilution Problem
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22164v1 — §7 Discussion; Appendix A assumptions; Appendix B Diluted Doors
problem: Multi-turn agents interleave consequential decisions with routine execution: some actions change the downstream return distribution, while others are necessary but reward-equivalent
mechanism: 多轮 RL 的难度由 decision density ρ 而非 raw horizon 单独决定；routine reward-equivalent turns 给 trajectory estimator 增方差但不增期望 signal，低 ρ 时需要 turn-level critic/credit。
evaluation_proof: 可精确调 ρ 的 controlled environment 复现 turn-level/trajectory-level SNR 比例，R²=0.999，并测 training-step gap。
non_proof: 推导依赖 critic error 受控与 routine turn 真正 reward-equivalent；受控环境不证明开放 agent 能可靠标出 decision turn。

benchmark_contract.workload: multi-turn RL with tunable consequential-decision density
benchmark_contract.model: 30K-parameter causal Transformer with two pre-norm blocks, model dimension 32, two attention heads and feed-forward width 128
benchmark_contract.batch: trajectory-level group G=16; turn-level Monte Carlo critic k=8; initialization SNR N=1,024
benchmark_contract.evaluator: gradient SNR and training iterations to threshold

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22175v1 — §II Implementation of an LLM-integrated Claim Verification Workflow; §III Transforming the Workflow to Enable StickyInvoc
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22175v1 — §I-E Limitation of the Proposed Approach
problem: The integration of LLMs into high-throughput workflows is creating a new class of workloads on HPC clusters that promises to accelerate advances in scientific discovery with unprecedented generative capabilities
mechanism: StickyInvoc 把昂贵 model/runtime state 的 create/destroy 与 invocation goodput 解耦：sticky task 持有 node-local state，后续 invocation 继承但不销毁，抢占时按 state owner 重建。
evaluation_proof: 145,449-claim PromptVerify workflow 在 20 GPU stable testbed 获 3.6×，并扩到 186 个闲置 GPU 后 784 秒完成。
non_proof: persistent state 会引入 version、tenant isolation、eviction 与 stale-state risk；作者 workflow 不证明交互式 tail latency 或任意 preemptible site。

benchmark_contract.workload: PromptVerify over 145,449 FEVER training claims
benchmark_contract.model: SmolLM2 1.7B
benchmark_contract.hardware: stable pool: 10 NVIDIA A10 + 10 TITAN X Pascal; scale-out up to 186 GPUs
benchmark_contract.batch: varied inference batch sizes in RQ3
benchmark_contract.evaluator: makespan, startup amortization and scale-out completion time

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22179v1 — §3 Problem Setup; §4 Confidence Constructions
problem: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as black-box classifiers in pipelines that automate confident decisions and route uncertain ones to human review
mechanism: selective prediction 除 calibration/ranking 还要报告 score granularity：可用阈值数量决定 operator 能选择多少风险工作点；多查询扩大分辨率但增加成本且可能伤害强模型排序。
evaluation_proof: 9 个 LLM、3 个 benchmark、25 个 model-dataset pair，对七种 confidence construction 比较 ranking、阈值粒度与 inference cost。
non_proof: 三 benchmark 与 black-box classification 不证明生成/agent risk；更细阈值不自动校准，重复查询还引入相关样本与成本。

benchmark_contract.workload: 2,890 BoolQ, MNLI and PubMedQA black-box classification examples
benchmark_contract.model: Llama-3.1-70B/8B, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Gemini-2.0-Flash-Lite, Claude-Haiku-4.5, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4.1-mini/nano and GPT-5-nano
benchmark_contract.evaluator: risk ranking, distinct threshold granularity and inference cost

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22180v1 — §5 FeLoG; §5.1 Feedback-coupled Sampling-Training Model; §5.2 Activity-aware Communication
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22180v1 — §7 Conclusions and experimental generalizability boundary
problem: Graph embedding maps graph nodes into low-dimensional vectors to support applications such as recommendation, fraud detection, and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG)
mechanism: FeLoG 用 embedding-quality feedback 优先 undertrained node；activity-aware sequence compression/选择同步降低 PCIe 与网络通信，round-interleaved pipeline 重叠下一轮 sampling 与当前 training。
evaluation_proof: 六个系统 baseline 与大图数据上平均 27.9× speedup、通信降超 53.1%、CPU-GPU utilization 超 80%。
non_proof: quality feedback 可能偏置 sampling，选择同步会制造 stale embedding；graph workloads 与硬件不证明 LLM training 或最终收敛等价。

benchmark_contract.workload: large-scale graph embedding with sampling and distributed training
benchmark_contract.model: FeLoG, PyTorch-BigGraph, DistDGL, DistGER, DistGER-G, NeutronTP and LeapGNN
benchmark_contract.hardware: 8 machines, each with a 2.60 GHz Intel Xeon Gold 6240 CPU (36 cores/72 threads), NVIDIA V100 32 GB, 192 GB DDR4 and full-duplex 10 Gbps networking; GraNNDis comparison on four NVIDIA A40 GPUs
benchmark_contract.evaluator: time-to-quality, communication volume and CPU-GPU utilization

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22189v1 — §3 System Overview; §4 Data Quality and Contamination Control; §5 Training Efficiency
problem: Small language models are cheap to serve and feasible on local hardware, but strong public 135M-class systems are commonly trained with hundreds of billions to trillions of tokens on large clusters
mechanism: 在单张 L20 上公开 134.5M 模型的 data gate、cross-source MinHash/LSH、segment dedup、benchmark-overlap removal、SFT weight interpolation 与 RLVR 全链。
evaluation_proof: 约 13B token、自跑六任务 harness；均分 0.4150；直接 GRPO-style RLVR 使 GSM8K exact match 从 1.82% 降至 1.59%/1.21%。
non_proof: 单 run、自有 harness、小模型与 nominal-token ratio 不证明 scaling law 或统计等价；RLVR 下降只是具体 failure case。

benchmark_contract.workload: single-GPU 134.5M language-model pretraining, SFT and RLVR
benchmark_contract.model: L20-Edu-135M, SmolLM-135M, SmolLM2-135M, Qwen2.5-0.5B, OLMo-1B and older 100M–160M baselines
benchmark_contract.evaluator: six-task zero-shot mean and GSM8K exact match

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22203v1 — §3 The Coupling Gain; §4 Theory
problem: LLM "agent societies" are studied via demonstrations of emergent consensus or polarization -- with no measurable control parameter, no theory of when each regime appears, and no test of whether an outcome is a genuine social dynamic or a model artifact
mechanism: 先用 counterfactual neighbor perturbation 测 coupling gain，再以 target-interaction modality-matched group coupling 选择 consensus dynamics；随机初值 slope/bias 区分 genuine averaging 与 model prior。
evaluation_proof: 5 个 frontier model 测 pairwise gamma，16 个 closed/open model 测 group coupling；复核既有 emergent-consensus 结果并发现 settled facts 上是 prior artifact。
non_proof: pairwise gamma 不能预测 multi-neighbor 结果且可反向排序；default agents 未自发 backfire，polarization 均为外部诱导，实验舆论任务不等于真实社会。

benchmark_contract.workload: LLM-agent opinion dynamics under pairwise and group interaction
benchmark_contract.model: deepseek-v4-pro, gpt-5.5, claude-opus-4.8, gemini-3.5-flash, qwen3.7-max, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-4-Maverick, Qwen-2.5-7B, Qwen-2.5-72B, Mistral-Large, Mistral-Small, Mixtral-8x22B, Gemma-2-27B and DeepSeek-Chat
benchmark_contract.evaluator: coupling gain, final-versus-initial slope/bias, consensus and polarization regime

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22248v1 — §3 SamatNext v0.2-B Architecture; §4 Curriculum and Evaluation Setup
problem: Standard autoregressive Transformer decoders can often exhibit substantial forgetting under sequential fine-tuning on shifting curriculum distributions
mechanism: SamatNext 交替 Differential-Attention 与简化 DeltaNet state mixer，用 RMS normalization/output calibration 测试 staged code curriculum 的 retention/plasticity。
evaluation_proof: 356M 参数、受控 Python curriculum；Stage 5 100%、相邻 Stage 3 保留 98.8%，但早期 Stage 2E 仅 12%；matched Transformer Stage 3 仅 6%。
non_proof: 单一受控 curriculum、单 architecture size 且 long-horizon retention 仍弱；不能外推为解决 catastrophic forgetting。

benchmark_contract.workload: sequential Python-code curriculum
benchmark_contract.model: SamatNext v0.2-B 356M and a parameter-matched Transformer
benchmark_contract.evaluator: current-stage pass rate and adjacent/early-stage semantic retention

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22263v1 — §III Design of Revelio; §III-C Hypothesis Confirmation by PoV Construction
problem: Memory safety vulnerabilities remain a significant threat even for projects with extensive fuzzing and manual auditing
mechanism: Revelio 让廉价 LLM/static analysis 只生成和排序 vulnerability hypothesis，最终必须提交 executable Proof-of-Vulnerability 并由 deterministic sanitizer 复现后才报告。
evaluation_proof: 7 个持续 fuzz 5–8 年的生产项目与 100 个随机 Arvo/CyberGym 项目；约每项目 1 小时、总成本 300 美元，发现 19 个未知 memory-safety 漏洞。
non_proof: sanitizer 只覆盖可触发 memory-safety failure；未复现不等于无漏洞，项目/时间预算与 benchmark selection 限制 recall 结论。

benchmark_contract.workload: seven mature production projects and 100 randomly selected Arvo/CyberGym projects
benchmark_contract.model: Claude Haiku 4.5 for hypothesis generation and Claude Sonnet 4.6 for PoV construction; Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5 and Sorcar baselines
benchmark_contract.evaluator: sanitizer-confirmed vulnerabilities, targeted recall and token cost

method_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22283v1 — §Part II Reaching the ANE — Software stack; Dispatching without Core ML; §Part VI The Silicon — Datapath and MAC geometry; §Part VII The Toolchain and Encoding; §Part VIII System Internals
evaluation_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22283v1 — §Part III Performance and Fit — Roofline; Power and efficiency; Across the chip family; Appendix A Operation-by-device matrix; Appendix E Provenance
limitations_locator: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.22283v1 — §Part V Practice — Pitfalls and limits; §Methodology; §Open questions; §Introduction — direct route is undocumented, unsupported and version-fragile
problem: The Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is the fixed-function matrix accelerator that has shipped in Apple systems-on-chip since the A11-class iPhone and iPad chips and the M1-class Mac chips, exposed to applications only through the Core ML model framework
mechanism: 对 ANE 的 datapath、roofline、compiler/on-disk format、weight compression、driver/firmware command protocol建立 measured/decompile-derived/predicted 三类 claim，并区分 direct private route 与 Core ML supported path。
evaluation_proof: A11–A18、M1–M5 目标表；直接测量只在 M1/M5，结合静态分析给出 operation-device matrix 与性能/能耗边界。

benchmark_contract.evaluator: measured roofline/energy plus operation-by-device support matrix
